fusions.name: Dive on the Faltering
fusions.desc: A stooping thrust on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Downdraft Slash
fusions.desc: A descending cut whose wind deals 12 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Hollow-Boned Quickness
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Glide
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your physical damage by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
